body_markdown:
**New York, NY** –


[Taboola](http://taboola.com/) (Nasdaq: TBLA) today announced it has been named one of


[Newsweek’s Most Admired Workplaces for 2027](https://bit.ly/4dS96uC) .


This ranking highlights 750 organizations recognized for attracting talent, fostering employee engagement and delivering a strong workplace experience. This is the third time Taboola has received placement on this prestigious ranking.


The complete rankings and methodology are available on Newsweek’s website and


[linked here](https://bit.ly/4dS96uC) .


America’s Most Admired Workplaces 2027, a collaboration between Newsweek and Plant-A Insights Group, recognizes the nation’s most desirable employers. The ranking highlights companies that excel at inspiring their existing workforce and attracting prospective employees, while also delivering a strong overall workplace experience.


The ranking is based on employee interviews, workplace satisfaction feedback, workforce metrics and a qualitative review by industry experts.
